Sponsor: Thermaltake TR200 WS mATX Case on Amazon https://geni.us/bviRvG
Cooler Master showed its new 12VHPWR sensing connector and power supply at Computex 2026, alongside its HAF II 500 high airflow PC case, 220mm fans (the Mighty 40 models that are 40mm deep), a new Hyper 212, and more. We're also joined by Wei to talk about the impact from oil prices on freight and consumer pricing briefly, following up his appearance in our documentary recently.

Watch our documentary on the collapse of the industry here, also featuring Wei: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zyQwAhppWj8
